data: Which line represents the highest number of parameters for an embedding dimensionality of 10?

The question asks which line represents the highest number of parameters for an embedding dimensionality of 10. From the caption, we know that the right graph shows the number of parameters under different embedding sizes. The lines in this graph correspond to n-CP, n-TuckER, and GETD. 

Looking at the right graph, we can see that the line representing n-TuckER is the highest among the three lines at an embedding dimensionality of 10. Therefore, the line representing n-TuckER corresponds to the highest number of parameters for an embedding dimensionality of 10.
